name: database-json
description: JSON import + export for notion-database. JsonActions (Export + Import dropdown) + JsonImportDialog (file picker + schema-diff preview) + lib/serialize.ts helpers (parseExport / diffSchema / buildImportResult / exportDatabase / downloadJson). Single-callback API — host owns persistence.
notes: CK-J wave (2026-05-21) — lifted from upstream notion-page-clone database-json slice. Simplified vs upstream: dropped AI assist (lib/ai.ts + AIAssistDialog need AI router), dropped cover / blocks / sub-items / templates fields (not in rr Page/Database minimal shape). Wire format v1 carries name + icon + properties + views + rows only. Result shape MIRRORS database-csv's CsvImportResult — single host onImport handler can serve both.
